title: CLEO Project Info Schema
description: Device-local project metadata (.cleo/project-info.json, untracked per ADR-013 §9). The committed identity lives in .cleo/project.json {schemaVersion, id, name} (T12716; legacy mirror .cleo/project-id); here projectId is only a cache of that id, and name is a frozen legacy value. Also carries origin provenance, the per-checkout nonce and schema version tracking.

projectId.description: Cache of the tracked portable id in .cleo/project.json (T12716; legacy .cleo/project-id). The tracked id always wins; a cache that disagrees is re-keyed only by `cleo doctor project-identity --resolve`. Used alone only by a project with no tracked id yet.

checkoutNonce.description: Random per-checkout secret (T12470). Lives only in this untracked file; the global registry records it on each confirmed location, so a moved or restored checkout is recognised while a clone (which cannot have it) stays an unconfirmed candidate. Never copy it between checkouts.

projectHash.description: Write-once 12-character hex identity key. Keys release ids, audit rows and idempotency. A new key is SHA-256('project-id:' + id) prefix, identical on every clone (T12716); keys written before T12716 are the SHA-256 prefix of the real main-checkout path. Never re-computed: not on project move, relocation, restore or `cleo upgrade` (T12557).

previousProjectIds.description: Local ids this project was re-keyed away from by `cleo doctor project-identity --resolve` (T12353). Receipt only; they stay resolvable through the registry alias table.

strippedFields.description: Receipt of persisted path facts removed by `cleo doctor project-identity --resolve` (T12557), newest last.

name.description: Legacy name, written once (the directory basename at init). Kept only as the input to the path-fingerprint alias key older builds recorded. The display name lives in .cleo/project.json (T12716); it is read from here only for a legacy project not yet migrated by `cleo doctor project-identity --resolve`, and `cleo project rename` writes it only for such a project.

description.description: Optional human-readable project description. Surfaces in nexus workspace listings and shared .cleo/ manifests.

remoteUrl.description: Git remote origin URL (e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo.git). Detected at init time from git remote get-url origin. Null when no git remote exists. Provides source-code provenance for shared .cleo/ containers.

cleoVersion.description: CLEO version that last modified this file (semver).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of initial project creation (cleo init). Set once and preserved across moves and updates.

lastUpdated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last modification to this file.

schemas.description: Schema versions for core CLEO data files in this project. Used for schema-migration-aware init.

sqlite.description: Schema version for tasks.db SQLite store (semver).

todo.description: Deprecated: JSON todo.json schema version. Kept for backward compatibility.

archive.description: Deprecated: JSON archive schema version. Kept for backward compatibility.

log.description: Deprecated: JSON log schema version. Kept for backward compatibility.
